definition: the part of a view behind the main thing
description: A young man in a white T-shirt, blue shorts and sandals waters a small vegetable garden with a hose on a sunny day, holding up a bunch of ripe red tomatoes from a plant. Behind the wooden garden fence, filling the whole background, a gigantic white cruise ship with a name on its hull glides past on the water, smoke rising from its funnel. The man looks up and speaks, then keeps watering. A deckchair, a metal watering can and pots of herbs stand on the brick path.

de.answer: Er spritzt die Tomatenpflanzen mit einem Schlauch ab.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está rociando las tomateras con una manguera.
